description:
VDClip turns long videos into short-form content, end to end, inside ChatGPT. Paste a YouTube or video URL and its AI finds the strongest moments and extracts them as ready-to-post clips, each ranked by a virality score so the best ones surface first. It can also caption a full video instead, transcribing in 22 languages.

From there, refine any clip in a live mini-editor that renders inside the conversation: restyle animated captions, add background music, apply your brand colors, fonts and logo, reframe to 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9, and adjust the timeline. Every change is previewed as an exact diff before it is applied, and anything that removes content asks for confirmation first.

When a clip is ready, render it to MP4 and publish or schedule it to your connected TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook accounts, including bulk scheduling across a week. VDClip quotes the credit cost before starting any paid job and never posts without your approval.

defaultPrompt: Turn my YouTube video into vertical short clips.
Show me my content calendar for this week.
